# Version 4.156.3 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering and allocation hardening**

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.3/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.103/index.md)

## Highlights

The 4.156.3 servicing changes correct image filtering, glyph cropping and GPU draw handling without changing managed APIs.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Filtered images and glyph bounds** — Ganesh image filters avoid mipmaps that can sample unwritten scratch-texture pixels. FreeType LCD16 glyph copies use pixel-space bounds and consistently crop source and destination when successive glyph loads produce different outlines. ([#5837](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5837))
- **GPU draw safety and ordering** — Ganesh rejects overflowing buffer allocations and skips draws when allocation fails, and destination reads are clipped to their bounds. Graphite resets depth and bounds after full-overwrite draws so repeated overwrites do not wrap depth and change painter order. ([#5837](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5837))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.103

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
